figures.caption: The four plans side by side: price, and which token pools each one gets.
figures.alt: Four plan cards, Free at $0, Basic at $9, Moderate at $29 and Ultimate at $79 a month, above a grid of monthly allowances. Standard tokens grow from 300 thousand to 6 million; Advanced, Expert and Brain token pools appear only in the higher plans; totals run from 0.3 million to 9.85 million tokens.
